CITY OF SAN GABRIEL
  Human Access, Equity and Relations (HEAR) Commission
  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  Wednesday, April 28, 2021- 6:30 P.M.

  City Hall Council Chamber
  425 South Mission Drive
  San Gabriel, 91776
  Due to Executive Order N-25-20 Members of the
  Commission may Teleconference into the meeting.
  Jacqueline Borja
  Commissioner

  Michelle Brenhaug  Mark Lazzaretto
  Commissioner  City Manager

  Susan Fitzsimmons  Keith Lemieux
  Commissioner  City Attorney

  Viki Goto  Julie Nguyen
  Commissioner  City Clerk

  Commissioner

  Commissioner

Pursuant to State and County Directives, San Gabriel City Hall is closed to the public and physical
access to the meeting has been suspended. To provide members of the public access to the meeting
and an opportunity to comment on items on and off the Agenda, the following opportunities have
been established:

Public Comments

Please email all public comments to mmoralesstevens@sgch.org and include the following on the
subject line of your email: the section (Public Comment, New Business, Staff Items) and Item Number
you are commenting on. Staff will read public comments into the record for up to the three-minute
limit. Words that would disrupt the meeting, including profanity, obscenity, and discriminatory
language, will not be read.
Example: PUBLIC COMMENT: New Business Item A
Watch the Meeting Online
Live broadcasts of the meetings are available using the following link:
https://www.youtube.com/CityofSanGabriel
   HUMAN ACCESS EQUITY AND RELATIONS COMMISSION AGENDA
  April 28, 2021

  CALL TO ORDER

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  ROLL CALL: Jacqueline Borja, Michelle Brenhaug, Susan Fitzsimmons, Viki Goto,
  Jorge Herrera, Chasity Jennings-Nuñez, and Riaz (Rick) Kahn

  APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

1.  PUBLIC COMMENTS

  This is the time set aside for members of the public to address the HEAR
  Commission on items of interest that are not on the agenda, but are within the
  subject matter jurisdiction of the HEAR Commission. Pursuant to the Brown Act,
  the HEAR Commission cannot answer any questions or take any action until such
  time as the matter may appear as an item on a future agenda.

2.  INTRODUCTIONS AND WELCOME

  Mark Lazzaretto, City Manager

3.  INTRODUCTION OF STAFF

  Rebecca Perez, Community Services Director/ Interim Mission Playhouse Director
  Lucy Hakobian, Community Services Manager (HEAR Commission Oversight)
  Matthew Morales-Stevens, Recreation Supervisor (HEAR Commission Liaison)
  Danielle Adriano, Recreation Specialist (Secretary to HEAR Commission)

4.  INTRODUCTION OF COMMISSION MEMBERS

  Jacqueline Borja, Commissioner
  Michelle Brenhaug, Commissioner
  Susan Fitzsimmons, Commissioner
  Viki Goto, Commissioner
  Jorge Herrera, Commissioner
  Chasity Jennings-Nuñez, Commissioner
  Riaz (Rick) Kahn, Commissioner

 HEAR Commission Special Meeting Agenda – April 28, 2021  2
 5.  SELECTION OF CHAIR

6.  SELECTION OF VICE-CHAIR

7.  OVERVIEW OF BROWN ACT AND OTHER LEGAL CONSIDERATIONS

  The City Attorney representative will provide an overview of the Brown Act, which
  guarantees the public’s right to attend and participate in meetings of local
  legislative bodies. Other legal considerations related to meeting participation,
  attendance, and protocol will be addressed.

8.  DISCUSSION AND DEVELOPMENT OF ANNUAL WORKPLAN

  The Commission will discuss items to be included in the Annual Workplan for
  submission to City Council to either approve or revise.

9.  MEETING SCHEDULE

  The HEAR Commission shall be held on the Fourth Tuesday of each month at
  6:30pm. Staff and the Commission will discuss future meetings dates, meeting
  times, and meeting location.

10.  ADJOURN COMMISSION MEETING

  The next Regular Commission meeting will be held on Tuesday, May 25, 2021 at
  6:30 p.m.

Materials Available for Inspection. You may view agenda items online at
www.sangabrielcity.com/agendacenter. Materials related to an item on this Agenda,
submitted to the Community Services Commission after distribution of the Agenda
packet, will be posted on the City website.
Persons with Disabilities. Upon request, this Agenda will be made available in
appropriate alternative formats to persons with disabilities, as required by Section 202 of
the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.
Persons requesting a Translator. Any person requesting translation for the meeting
must notify the City Clerk’s Department at cityclerk@sgch.org at least 48 hours before the
meeting.
Questions About This Agenda? Should any person have a question concerning any of
the above agenda items prior to the meeting, please contact the Community Services
Department in person or by telephone at (626) 308-2875 during regular office hours.

 Any person with a disability who requires a modification or accommodation in order to
participate in a meeting should direct such a request to the Community Services
Department at (626) 308-2875 at least 48 hours before the meeting, if possible.
